description: This file contains server-side code for the 'AdminQueue' page in an online examination system, managing course queue data, session validation, and navigation.

classes.name: AdminQueue
classes.description: Code-behind class for the AdminQueue Web Form, handling page events and database interactions for course queue management.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event; verifies session variables, checks course queue count, and performs cleanup if empty.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles redirection to the AdminPanel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Reloads or redirects back to the AdminQueue page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by redirecting to the LoginPage.

methods.name: GridView1_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection change in a GridView; stores selected student and course IDs in session and navigates to the ShowAns page.
